findings.issue: GET /books/:id/reviews does not validate that the book exists or that :id is numeric, unlike the sibling /books/:id/histogram route which calls Book.getBookById first and returns 404.
findings.evidence: Lines 34-38: `const bookId = parseInt(req.params.id as string, 10); const sort = ...; res.json(Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort));` with no Book.getBookById check, whereas /books/:id/histogram explicitly checks `if (!Book.getBookById(bookId)) return res.status(404)...`. A request for a non-existent or non-numeric book id (e.g. /books/999999/reviews or /books/abc/reviews) silently returns `[]` with 200 instead of 404.
